scripts.@totemsdk/statechain:
LET owner=STATE(0)
IF @COINAGE GTE 256 THEN
  RETURN SIGNEDBY(owner)
ENDIF
ASSERT MULTISIG(2 owner 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA)
RETURN TRUE
scripts.@totemsdk/omnia:
LET settlement=STATE(100)
LET sequence=STATE(101)
LET prevsequence=PREVSTATE(101)
LET bothsigned=MULTISIG(2 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA 0xBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB)
IF settlement THEN
    ASSERT bothsigned
    ASSERT sequence EQ prevsequence
    ASSERT @COINAGE GTE 256
    RETURN TRUE
ENDIF
ASSERT bothsigned
ASSERT sequence GT prevsequence
RETURN TRUE
scripts.@totemsdk/omnia-factory:
LET settlement=STATE(100)
ASSERT SAMESTATE(103 103)
ASSERT SAMESTATE(111 111)
IF @BLOCK GT PREVSTATE(103) THEN
  LET share=PREVSTATE(128)
  IF SIGNEDBY(0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA) THEN
    IF share GT 0 THEN
      ASSERT VERIFYOUT(0 0xc383b6d2136197346f3f756e7554a0af1a515613fd1b8f5e01508365354faf4f share @TOKENID FALSE)
      ASSERT STATE(129) EQ PREVSTATE(129)
      ASSERT STATE(128) EQ 0
      IF @AMOUNT GT share THEN
        RETURN VERIFYOUT(1 @ADDRESS @AMOUNT - share @TOKENID TRUE)
      ENDIF
      RETURN TRUE
    ENDIF
  ENDIF
  LET share=PREVSTATE(129)
  IF SIGNEDBY(0xBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB) THEN
    IF share GT 0 THEN
      ASSERT VERIFYOUT(0 0x65e5dadfc2c13c7f5382a08c558b1da32d2580b1a0f2f7843497e743dc8a3761 share @TOKENID FALSE)
      ASSERT STATE(128) EQ PREVSTATE(128)
      ASSERT STATE(129) EQ 0
      IF @AMOUNT GT share THEN
        RETURN VERIFYOUT(1 @ADDRESS @AMOUNT - share @TOKENID TRUE)
      ENDIF
      RETURN TRUE
    ENDIF
  ENDIF
ENDIF
ASSERT MULTISIG(2 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA 0xBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB)
IF settlement THEN
    IF @COINAGE GTE 1 THEN RETURN TRUE ENDIF
ELSE
    RETURN TRUE
ENDIF
scripts.@totemsdk/omnia-vtxo:
LET epoch=STATE(101)
LET exitblock=PREVSTATE(102)
IF @BLOCK GT exitblock THEN
  LET share=PREVSTATE(128)
  IF SIGNEDBY(0xBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB) THEN
    IF share GT 0 THEN
      ASSERT VERIFYOUT(0 0x65e5dadfc2c13c7f5382a08c558b1da32d2580b1a0f2f7843497e743dc8a3761 share @TOKENID FALSE)
      ASSERT STATE(128) EQ 0
      IF @AMOUNT GT share THEN
        RETURN VERIFYOUT(1 @ADDRESS @AMOUNT - share @TOKENID TRUE)
      ENDIF
      RETURN TRUE
    ENDIF
  ENDIF
ENDIF
ASSERT epoch GT PREVSTATE(101)
ASSERT SAMESTATE(102 102)
ASSERT VERIFYOUT(@INPUT @ADDRESS @AMOUNT @TOKENID TRUE)
RETURN MULTISIG(2 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA 0xBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB)
